subject: FintechCorp security follow-up: SOC 2, vendor questionnaire, IR timelines & BCP evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintechcorp.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: security discovery + next steps (SOC 2 / IR timelines / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Alice / Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Summary: FintechCorp is evaluating Redwood for transaction enrichment and real-time risk scoring. Your primary controls questions were SOC 2 status, breach notification timelines, GDPR/HIPAA support, and vendor questionnaire evidence.

Action items we discussed:
1) We'll share our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short BCP/DR checklist.
2) Please send the vendor security questionnaire (or a link) — we can start filling it out and assign an owner.
3) We can provide a high-level incident response (IR) timeline and sample breach notification text for your legal/security review.
4) If needed, we can schedule a follow-up IR tabletop or technical deep-dive next week.

For transparency: we aim to provide the SOC 2 attestation and IR summary within 48 business hours once we have a signed NDA or the questionnaire link. Our typical breach-notification commitment in contracts is 72 hours for confirmed incidents, with immediate remediation and regular updates (we can put this into a proposed clause).

I’ve CC’d Marissa from our security/compliance team to start pulling docs. Ben from engineering will join the tabletop if you want a technical lead there.

Next proposed step: Can you either attach the questionnaire or share a link and confirm whether your legal team needs an NDA first?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@fintechcorp.com>, security@fintechcorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security discovery + next steps (SOC 2 / IR timelines / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the recap and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from the security team: 

- We will need the SOC 2 Type II report but typically only after an NDA is in place. Can you send your standard mutual NDA?
- Please confirm whether Redwood can support HIPAA (business associate) requirements for PHI in the event we route any healthcare-related transactions through your service. If so, an additional BAA conversation will be needed.
- For breach notification: we require confirmation of your 72-hour notification window for confirmed breaches and a higher-level description of your IR escalation (who is notified internally and the cadence of updates).

I’m CC’ing our security inbox. I’ll attach our vendor questionnaire, but to speed things up here’s a link to the hosted form: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-fintech-questionnaire (Security will assign a reviewer).

If you can send the SOC 2 summary + an IR timeline and the NDA, we’ll route them to legal/security and come back with specific evidence requests (logs, audit trails, DR test results).

Thanks — Alice
Alice Wong
Head of Security Assessments | FintechCorp
alice.wong@fintechcorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintechcorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security discovery + next steps (SOC 2 / IR timelines / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Alice — thanks for the link. Jordan — looping in a few internal notes and what we can provide immediately.

We can share the following within 48 business hours pending NDA: 
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF stub: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf)
- Incident Response (IR) plan excerpt + notification cadence (see attached IR_Plan_v2.pdf)
- BCP / DR checklist and summary of last DR test (spreadsheet stub: BCP_DR_Checklist.xlsx)

Clarifications: 
- HIPAA: Redwood supports deployments where PHI can be processed, but we require a BAA and certain deployment configurations (private VPC or dedicated). We are happy to have our legal team engage on the BAA.
- Breach notification: our standard language commits to 72 hours from incident confirmation for customer notification; during triage we provide frequent status updates (initial notice, 24-48 hour cadence until resolved). We will include the internal roles (SRE lead, Head of Security, Customer Success lead) in the escalation flow.

I’ll start populating the vendor questionnaire. Action items on our side:
- Jordan: send mutual NDA (I can attach SOC after NDA is returned).
- Ben: please confirm the last DR test date and high-level outcome so we can include it in the checklist.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: IR_Plan_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 142 KB)
Attachment: BCP_DR_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 58 KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@fintechcorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security discovery + next steps (SOC 2 / IR timelines / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Alice — quick technical notes to supplement Marissa’s notes: 

- Breach notification timing: confirmed incidents -> 72 hours for initial customer notification; we then provide follow-up updates at ~24-48 hour intervals depending on impact. For regulatory obligations (e.g., PD/PI breach thresholds), we work with your legal team on specific timelines.
- IR escalation: initial detection -> SRE on-call -> Incident Commander (Head of Security) -> Customer Success escalation. We can provide a contact list for each role if needed.
- DR/BCP: last full DR test was 2027-06-11 (tabletop + partial failover test). Recovery objectives: RTO 2 hours for critical inference endpoints, RPO < 15 minutes (dependent on config).

I’ve attached the IR plan excerpt and BCP checklist Marissa referenced. Happy to join a tabletop review — propose Wed 2027-09-08 10:00 PT as an option.

Ben Carter
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: IR_Plan_v2.pdf
Attachment: BCP_DR_Checklist.xlsx

Jordan / Marissa — thanks, we received the attachments and timeline summary. Security will begin their review tomorrow. A couple items from legal/security: 

- We need a mutual NDA signed before we can accept the SOC 2 report. Please send the DocuSign link or your standard NDA PDF.
- We have started the vendor questionnaire and assigned a reviewer. I’m also including our procurement contact (Tom) for any contract redlines.
- Please confirm the main point of contact for SOC 2 questions (name + email) so we can route follow-ups.

I’ve uploaded our questionnaire and put some initial notes in row 2. You can find it here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-fintech-questionnaire

I’ve also started an internal request for expedited review of IR/BCP items given this is high-priority. We’ll expect the SOC 2 after NDA; for now if you can provide the SOC 2 cover letter or summary that’s non-sensitive, that could help speed review.

Alice Wong
Head of Security Assessments | FintechCorp
security@fintechcorp.com
